 BATTLEFIELD 6 GAME UPDATE 1.4.3.5
 September 28, 2026
 
 
 
 

 TABLE OF CONTENTS

 Key Updates for 1.4.3.5 
 Changelog 
 REDSEC 
 
 

 Battlefield 6 Game Update 1.4.3.5 is a smaller quality-of-life update featuring targeted fixes across menus, the HUD, social features, game modes, maps, AI behaviour, and general stability.

 At 08:00 UTC tomorrow, Wednesday, September 30, players will be able to download the update across all platforms.

 Key Updates for 1.4.3.5

 More Reliable Menus and HUD: Social information, the downed-state minimap, and End of Round navigation now behave more consistently.
 Cleaner Match Experience: Targeted map, mode, and AI updates reduce disruptive environment issues and improve behaviour during matches.
 PS5 and Stability Improvements: Game launch reliability, optic presentation, and Spectator mode stability have been improved.
 
 CHANGELOG

 PLAYER: 

 Dev Note: Based on community feedback, we’ve removed the class restrictions from the Lt. Bradley “Rooster” Bradshaw and Lt. Robert “Bob” Floyd character skins. Both can now be used with any NATO class, giving players more flexibility to use their Top Gun cosmetics across the battlefield.

 Quitting to the main menu at End of Round no longer results in an endless loading screen.
 Resolved a crash that could occur in Spectator mode during large-scale experiences.
 The Bob and Rooster soldier characters and their associated skins can now be used across all Nato classes.
 The skin icons for the Bob and Rooster soldier characters no longer display class-specific gadgets.
 
 WEAPONS: 

 Scope edges now display at the intended thickness on PS5 for the following optics: SU-123, CCO, Ro-M, 2PRO, 3VZR, R4T, 1P86 Variable, 1p88 variable, NFX, and SSDS.
 
 MAPS & MODES: 

 Removed two invisible barriers on Wake Island that could obstruct movement inside a bunker near Objective E.
 The APHEI Cannon can no longer damage the carrier in Carrier Strike.
 
 UI & HUD: 

 After backing out of a Battlefield Coins purchase, players can now navigate to the purchase button as intended.
 Phantom Program XP Booster rewards now display the correct icons at End of Round.
 The minimap now displays while the player is downed.
 
 AI: 

 AI-controlled vehicles now navigate shallow water more reliably on Tsuru Reef, preventing them from becoming submerged.
 
 REDSEC

 MAP: 

 Removed a floating zipline from the elevator shaft in the Tech Campus POI.
 
 UI & HUD: 

 Platform icons now display correctly in the Proximity Chat “Recent Interactions” menu in Battle Royale.
 
 This announcement may change as we listen to community feedback and continue developing and evolving our Live Service & Content. We will always strive to keep our community as informed as possible.
